title.en: DeepSeek Rolls Out General Availability Release of Flagship DeepSeek-V4-Pro
title.zhHans: DeepSeek 旗舰模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 正式版（GA）全渠道上线

searchSummary.en: DeepSeek launched the GA release of DeepSeek-V4-Pro across App, Web, and API, demonstrating significant performance gains on agent benchmarks.
searchSummary.zhHans: DeepSeek 旗舰模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 正式版（GA）在 App、Web 及 API 全面上线，智能体评测表现显著提升。

summary.en: On August 13, 2026, DeepSeek announced the General Availability (GA) rollout of its flagship DeepSeek-V4-Pro model across its mobile application, web interface, and developer API, delivering substantial performance gains on production-grade autonomous agent and software engineering benchmarks.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 13 日，DeepSeek 宣布其旗舰模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 正式版（GA）在移动 App、Web 网页端及开发者 API 全面上线，在生产级自主智能体与软件工程基准上取得显著性能提升。

narrative.en: DeepSeek transitioned its flagship DeepSeek-V4-Pro model from preview to a full General Availability (GA) deployment across consumer and developer surfaces. The GA checkpoint incorporates targeted post-training optimizations for autonomous tool calling, terminal interaction, and multi-file code refactoring. Official benchmark results reported Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) tool-assisted score reaching 60.0 (42.7 without tools), Terminal Bench 2.1 reaching 87.9, and DeepSWE achieving 62.7, cementing open-weight frontier performance in complex agentic workflows.
narrative.zhHans: DeepSeek 将其旗舰模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 从预览版升级为全渠道正式商用（GA）部署，覆盖消费端与开发者平台。该 GA 检查点融入了针对自主工具调用、终端交互以及多文件代码重构的定向后训练优化。官方公布的基准数据显示，其在人类最后考试（HLE）工具辅助评分下达到 60.0（无工具 42.7），Terminal Bench 2.1 达 87.9，DeepSWE 达 62.7，进一步夯实了开源前沿模型在复杂智能体工作流中的能力基础。

description.en: Flagship open-weight model achieves top-tier scores on complex coding and terminal agent benchmarks in production GA availability.
description.zhHans: 旗舰开源模型在生产级 GA 正式版中在复杂编程与终端智能体基准上取得前沿顶尖成绩。

text.en: DeepSeek rolled out the GA release of DeepSeek-V4-Pro across App, Web, and API on August 13, 2026, reporting HLE tool-assisted score of 60.0 and Terminal Bench 2.1 of 87.9.
text.zhHans: DeepSeek 于 2026 年 8 月 13 日在 App、Web 和 API 全面上线 DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA 正式版，公布 HLE 工具辅助得分 60.0 及 Terminal Bench 2.1 得分 87.9。

text.en: Provides an accessible frontier open model for production-grade autonomous agent and software engineering pipelines.
text.zhHans: 为生产级自主智能体与软件工程流水线提供了一款高可用性的前沿开源模型。

text.en: Benchmark scores reflect vendor evaluations and require long-term independent verification across diverse enterprise production workloads.
text.zhHans: 评测成绩主要基于官方披露基准，仍需在多样化的企业生产实际负载中接受长期独立复核。

editorial.reviewNotes: Published after official DeepSeek API changelog confirmation of full GA rollout. Reviewed 2026-08-24 after the latest-30 evidence, calibration, and language audit.

changeLog.summary: Replaced 404 TechNode source with Reuters coverage, downgraded significance from L2 to L1, changed consensus to emerging, and unlinked enterprise-workflows direction.
